decisions.reason: As a newly launched module close to the core practice software, it fits the firm's installed base and digital-integration strategy, so with likely organizational slack and still-limited performance feedback the firm would usually keep it unless early results fall clearly below aspiration levels.

Because the secure healthcare messaging service is prominently presented, tied to mandatory health-IT updates and regulation-driven workflows, and complements the firm's core offer, management would likely judge it as strategically important and keep it absent a major shortfall.
